affected_component: Journey autopilot stage recording (rehearsal/real_build) and stage payload persistence
invariant: An autopilot stage must report the reason codes, detail and owner of the substage that actually stopped the CLI build (for example stages.preflight), never a generic REHEARSAL_FAILED/REAL_BUILD_FAILED, and every stage's raw CLI payload must be persisted (record_dir/stages/<stage>.json and the journey's autopilot state dir) so the cause is recoverable from disk.
